This is right. I selected the first two cards, opened "Labels," and picked "Remove label → Design," and Design came off both cards while the selection cleared afterward. Putting add and remove together under one "Labels" control, with it spelling out which direction I'm doing before it happens, is clear and reassuring — I can see I'm removing rather than adding. The label side of the reverse actions is settled for me.

The one remaining bit from my reverse-actions request, though: the read/unread pair. I can bulk "Mark read," but I don't see a bulk "Mark unread" yet — so I can clear a batch off my read-later pile, but I can't put a batch back onto it in one go. Could we add bulk mark-unread to match, so read and unread work both ways just like the labels now do?
